text: Meet Sinehan. A movie theater for two.
No accounts. Pick a name, start a party, and your invite link is already copied.
They tap the link and land on the same show, at the same spot.
Press play together. Pause or skip on either side, and the other follows.
If one of you hits an ad, the other waits. Then a three, two, one starts you together.
Chat, react and video call without leaving the show. Hold hands from afar, or ask Bantay for a trick.
Not just movies. Swipe through Reels, and their phone follows.
Your phone becomes the remote, and the chat, from the couch.
Not sure what to watch? Ask Reddit for the best episodes, and tick them off together.
Go glass, dark or light, and pick Bantay's coat.
And Bantay keeps watch. No accounts, and your chats stay with you.
Same show. Same second. From two places. Sinehan, free for Chrome.
